title: Safety of Cultured Umbilical or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cell Intravenous Infusion for CP
official: Safety of Cultured Umbilical or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cell Intravenous Infusion for the Treatment of Cerebral Palsy
summary: This trial will study the safety and efficacy of intravenous infusion of cultured umbilical or placental derived mesenchymal stem cells for the treatment of Cerebral Palsy

interventions.name: Umbilical or placental derived mesenchymal stem cells

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Cerebral Palsy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active infection
* Active cancer
* Chronic multisystem organ failure
* Pregnancy
* Clinically significant Abnormalities on pre-treatment laboratory evaluation
* Medical condition that would (based on the opinion of the investigator) compromise patient's safety
* Previous organ transplant
* Seizure disorder
* Hypersensitivity to sulfur
sponsor: The Foundation for Orthopaedics and Regenerative Medicine
